5351.title: Inherited tool manifest breaks Pi catalog startup
5351.rootCauseOneLine: Pi catalog children inherit a deleted session tool-manifest path, which the BB extension opens during initialization.
5351.proposedFix: Drop the inherited Pi tools-manifest variable before applying explicit per-spawn overrides.
5351.caveats: Catalog/subprocess/real extension reproduced with repository fake Pi; macOS process ancestry and Pi 1.1.0 not verified. Executable test is inline per reports repository policy.
